tokyo_asakusa_sarashina_tenko.price_note: Prices tax-included, transcribed from the shop's own Soba / A la Carte / Course pages (site notice: menu last revised 2026-06-26) and cross-checked item by item against its own PDF allergen chart. Prices approximate — may change. A ¥550 otoshi (table charge) applies.

items.ja: せいろうそば
items.en: Chilled soba on a slatted box with dipping tsuyu — the shop's calling card. Choose 更科 (sarashina, pale inner flour) or 十割 (juwari, 100% buckwheat)
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 店の公式アレルゲン表で小麦・大麦とも「該当なし」、つゆは特製グルテンフリー辛汁。Shop's own allergen chart marks both 小麦 (wheat) and 大麦 (barley) 該当なし, and unusually for Japan the dipping tsuyu is a purpose-made gluten-free one — so here even the 十割 really is safe, unlike almost every other soba shop. Tsuyu contains fish (魚介), so not vegan.

items.ja: 鴨せいろうそば
items.en: Cold soba with a hot dipping broth built on chopped duck and scorched spring onion
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦 該当なし。Allergen chart clears wheat and barley; the tsuyu is the house gluten-free one. Duck and fish stock.

items.ja: 米粉の天せいろうそば
items.en: Cold soba with prawn and seasonal-vegetable tempura fried in rice-flour batter
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 天麩羅粉は米粉。アレルゲン表は海老・卵を表示するが小麦は「該当なし」。The tempura flour is rice-based — the chart flags prawn and egg in it, not wheat. Gluten-free tempura barely exists in Tokyo; this is it.

items.ja: そばとろ
items.en: Cold soba with grated yamato-imo yam blended with iron-rich beetroot and enriched with egg yolk
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦 該当なし、卵あり。Chart clears wheat and barley; contains egg.

items.ja: かけそば
items.en: Hot soba in the Edo-style sweet broth (甘汁)
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 甘汁もグルテンフリー仕様、アレルゲン表で小麦・大麦「該当なし」。The hot 甘汁 broth is also made wheat-free per the shop; bonito/fish stock so not vegan.

items.ja: 米粉の海老天そば
items.en: Hot soba with rice-flour prawn tempura
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: 米粉衣。アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦 該当なし。Rice-flour batter; chart flags prawn, egg and fish but not wheat.

items.ja: 鴨芹そば
items.en: Hot soba with duck fat and Japanese parsley (seri) in the sweet broth
items.section: おそば クラシック Classic soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦 該当なし、鴨・魚介あり。Chart clears wheat and barley.

items.ja: 和牛蕎麦
items.en: Cold soba with sukiyaki-style simmered wagyu sirloin and plenty of egg yolk
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: すき焼き風の割下も店のグルテンフリー醤油仕様、アレルゲン表で小麦 該当なし。The sukiyaki-style braising liquid uses the house gluten-free soy — the chart shows no wheat. Contains egg and beef.

items.ja: 生雲丹蕎麦
items.en: Cold soba tangled with raw sea urchin and egg yolk, with crunchy tenkasu
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: 天かすは蕎麦粉と米粉製。アレルゲン表：小麦 該当なし、卵・魚介あり。The tenkasu here is made from buckwheat and rice flour, not wheat — that is why it clears the chart.

items.ja: 鶏白湯蕎麦
items.en: The richest bowl on the card: creamy chicken paitan deepened with niboshi sardine, topped with pork, duck and chicken chashu
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：卵（煮卵）・魚介（蒲鉾）・豚・鶏・鴨あり、小麦・大麦 該当なし。Chart flags egg, fish cake and three meats but no wheat or barley — a chashu-topped bowl that is still gluten-free is close to unheard of.

items.ja: 塩生姜おかめ蕎麦
items.en: Bone-broth soba sharpened with salted ginger, the garnishes laid out as the face of Okame the folk mask
items.section: おそば モダン Modern soba
items.note: アレルゲン表：卵（煮卵）・魚介（蒲鉾）・豚あり、小麦・大麦 該当なし。Chart clears wheat and barley.

items.ja: そばの追加（大盛り／追加つゆ／追加薬味／追加せいろう／ろく助の塩）
items.en: Soba add-ons: large portion +¥330 · extra tsuyu +¥385 · extra condiments +¥220 · extra soba box +¥660 · Rokusuke salt +¥150
items.section: おそば 追加 Soba add-ons
items.note: つゆ・蕎麦とも店のグルテンフリー仕様（アレルゲン表）。Both the noodle and the tsuyu are the shop's gluten-free versions per its own allergen chart. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 焼き蕎麦がき
items.en: Buckwheat 'dumpling' — soba flour and whole groats kneaded together and oven-roasted. The opener every course starts with
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。The allergen chart shows all fourteen listed allergens 該当なし for this dish — the cleanest thing on the card. Price not published separately (it comes as the otoshi).

items.ja: 蕎麦前盛り合わせ
items.en: Five-piece assortment of the house drinking snacks — order it while you wait for the soba. Two portions minimum
items.note: 警告：アレルゲン表で大麦（山ウニ）と胡桃（味噌ナッツ）が「入っている」。WARNING — the shop's own chart flags 大麦 (barley) in this platter, via the 山ウニ condiment, plus walnut. Barley is gluten. This is the one sobamae dish here a coeliac must refuse, and it is also the platter built into all three courses.

items.ja: きつね焼き
items.en: A slab of thick fried tofu from Fukuoka's celebrated Mihara Tofu, oven-crisped; eaten plain with ginger-soy or with toppings you choose
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。生姜醤油は店のグルテンフリー醤油を指定のこと。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし. It is served with ginger-soy — ask for the house gluten-free soy. Vegan only if you skip bonito-type toppings — ask.

items.ja: 大葉と大粒納豆
items.en: Large-bean natto dressed in the house mentsuyu, finished with shiso leaf
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」、自家製めんつゆはグルテンフリー。Chart clears everything, and the house mentsuyu is the gluten-free one — ordinary natto sauce is soy-and-wheat, so this is a real distinction. Mentsuyu is dashi-based; ask about bonito for vegan.

items.ja: 焼き海苔
items.en: Grilled Edomae nori from Funabashi Sanbanze, with real wasabi
items.note: 店が「お好みでグルテンフリーの醤油で」と明記。アレルゲン表は海苔の海老・蟹コンタミのみ、小麦・大麦なし。Shop explicitly offers its gluten-free soy with it; the only chart flag is a shrimp/crab cross-contact note on the nori itself. Plant-only.

items.ja: 板わさ『萩』
items.en: Sliced kamaboko fish cake sent direct from Miyoshi Kamaboko in Yamaguchi — 100% domestic lizardfish — with wasabi
items.note: 店の表記「国産鮮魚エソ100%のグルテンフリーな蒲鉾」、アレルゲン表も小麦・大麦「該当なし」。The shop's own wording is 'gluten-free kamaboko'. Most kamaboko is bound with wheat starch, so this is a deliberate choice, and the chart backs it. Fish.

items.ja: 焼きそば味噌ナッツ
items.en: House paste of Ishino Saikyo miso and toasted buckwheat groats with nuts — built for sake
items.note: アレルゲン表：胡桃・蕎麦あり、小麦・大麦「該当なし」（西京味噌＝米味噌で麦味噌ではない）。Chart flags walnut and buckwheat but clears wheat and barley — Saikyo miso is a rice miso, not the barley 麦味噌 that would carry gluten. Walnut allergy warning.

items.ja: 酔っ払い鴨とあんぽ柿
items.en: Duck simmered slowly in rum, served against the dense sweetness of semi-dried anpo persimmon
items.note: アレルゲン表：鴨のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags only duck. Rum, not a malt spirit.

items.ja: 尾崎牛もも肉炙りユッケ
items.en: Seared Ozaki-beef round, chopped tartare-style; mix in the thick egg yolk and eat with the house foamed soy
items.note: 店が「グルテンフリーの泡醤油」と明記、アレルゲン表も小麦「該当なし」。The shop names its 泡醤油 as gluten-free and the chart agrees. Egg and beef.

items.ja: 本鮪のにら醤油
items.en: Selected bluefin tuna in a fragrant garlic-chive soy
items.note: アレルゲン表（やま幸 鮪 ニラ醤油）：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart lists fish only; the nira-shoyu is made with the house gluten-free soy.

items.ja: 本日の鮮魚の刺身
items.en: The day's recommended fish as sashimi, with the house gluten-free ponzu and mustard
items.note: 自家製ポン酢はグルテンフリー（店の記載）、アレルゲン表：魚介のみ。The house ponzu is stated gluten-free; chart flags fish only. Price varies with the market — ask.

items.ja: 飛騨ジャンボなめことわさび芋
items.en: Fat Hida nameko mushrooms with fresh grated nagaimo yam and the house mentsuyu
items.note: 店が「グルテンフリーのめんつゆ」と明記、アレルゲン表は海苔のコンタミのみ。Shop names the mentsuyu as gluten-free; only a nori cross-contact flag on the chart. Mentsuyu is dashi — ask for vegan.

items.ja: 日光たぬき湯葉豆腐
items.en: Rich Nikko yuba tofu under crisp 'tanuki' crumbs made from nori, buckwheat and rice flour, with mentsuyu
items.note: 天かすは蕎麦粉・米粉製。アレルゲン表：卵あり、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。The crunchy bits are buckwheat and rice, not the wheat tenkasu this dish normally uses. Chart flags egg.

items.ja: 揚げ獅子唐葡萄七味
items.en: Shishito peppers deep-fried whole and dusted with grape shichimi
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。フライヤーは米粉のみの店。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし, and this kitchen's fryer only ever handles rice-flour batter — the shared-fryer problem that rules out fried food elsewhere does not apply.

items.ja: 和牛すじ肉と茄子の旨煮
items.romaji: wagyu suji to nasu no umani
items.en: Wagyu tendon simmered until it collapses, with aubergine that has drunk up the braise
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦「該当なし」（店のグルテンフリー醤油で煮る）。Chart flags beef only; braised in the house gluten-free soy.

items.ja: 生雲丹乗せ胡麻豆腐 旨出汁かけ
items.en: Silky sesame tofu topped with raw sea urchin under a gentle sweet dashi, scented with shiso
items.note: アレルゲン表：乳あり、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags dairy (English sheet) but no wheat. Uni and dashi.

items.ja: 香味野菜と蒸し鶏のサラダ
items.en: Aromatic herbs and moist steamed chicken in a light house dressing
items.note: アレルゲン表：鶏のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags chicken only — the dressing is wheat-free, which shop dressings usually are not.

items.ja: 大山鶏手羽一夜干し唐揚げ
items.en: Daisen chicken wings dried overnight in bone broth then fried until the skin shatters; Rokusuke salt and yuzu-kosho on the side
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦とも「該当なし」（衣に小麦粉を使わず、フライヤーも米粉専用）。Karaage is normally wheat-dusted and fried in a shared wheat fryer; here the chart clears both wheat and barley. The salt is flagged 魚介.

items.ja: 里芋のスパイシーフライ
items.en: Whole taro deep-fried until crisp outside and sticky inside, Cajun-spiced and salted
items.note: アレルゲン表：小麦・大麦「該当なし」、魚介（ろく助の塩）あり。Chart clears wheat and barley; the Rokusuke salt carries a fish flag, so ask before calling it vegan.

items.ja: 米粉の天麩羅盛り合わせ
items.en: Rice-flour tempura assortment — startlingly light
items.note: 衣は米粉。アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦「該当なし」。Rice-flour batter, dedicated fryer; chart flags prawn, egg and fish but not wheat.

items.ja: 海老天
items.en: Prawn tempura, two pieces, in the rice-flour batter
items.note: アレルゲン表：海老・卵・魚介あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.ja: 野菜の天麩羅盛り合わせ
items.en: Vegetable tempura assortment
items.note: アレルゲン表：卵（天麩羅粉）・魚介（塩）あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat but flags egg in the batter, so vegetable does not mean vegan here.

items.ja: 炙り明太子
items.en: Spicy pollock roe seared on the outside, still raw in the middle
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Mentaiko cure normally contains soy sauce; the chart here shows no wheat.

items.ja: かつを酒盗
items.en: Shuto — bonito innards salted and aged for months into a dense, briny paste. A Kochi delicacy, eaten in tiny amounts with sake
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（鰹酒盗）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags fish only.

items.ja: 季節の浅漬け
items.en: Lightly pickled seasonal vegetables — the palate cleanser between dishes
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし — no soy-sauce brine, no dashi.

items.ja: 和牛ミスジしゃぶしゃぶ（野菜付き）
items.en: Misuji (top blade) wagyu swished through a salt broth built on the shop's soba dashi, with vegetables and house ponzu. Finish it with 〆の十割蕎麦 or 〆の更科蕎麦 at ¥715
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。スープもポン酢も店のグルテンフリー仕様。Chart flags beef only; the broth and the ponzu are both the house wheat-free versions.

items.ja: 特上牛タンしゃぶしゃぶ（野菜付き）
items.en: Thin-sliced premium beef tongue through the same soba-dashi salt broth — a texture you do not get from grilled tongue
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart flags beef only.

items.ja: 合鴨の炭火焼き
items.en: Duck breast cooked low and slow, then finished over charcoal in the house yakitori tare
items.note: アレルゲン表：鴨・魚介（塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。自家製焼き鳥のタレもグルテンフリー。Yakitori tare is soy-and-mirin everywhere else; the chart shows this house version carries no wheat.

items.ja: 大山鶏もも肉醤油麹焼き
items.en: Chicken thigh marinated in shoyu-koji and grilled yuan-style — the soba shop's version of yakitori
items.note: アレルゲン表：鶏のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Shoyu-koji is normally wheat-fermented; the chart clears this one.

items.ja: 和牛サーロイン 140g
items.en: Wagyu sirloin with salt, real wasabi and a house onion sauce
items.note: アレルゲン表：牛・魚介（塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat and barley.

items.ja: 神戸牛溶岩焼きステーキ
items.en: Kobe beef cooked to your liking on a searing lava stone at the table
items.note: アレルゲン表に未掲載。Not on the published allergen chart (it is a newer addition). The kitchen is wheat-flour-free but confirm the sauce before ordering.

items.ja: 神戸牛・まぐろ・サーモン 手巻き寿司セット
items.en: Roll-your-own hand-roll set with Kobe beef, tuna and salmon
items.note: アレルゲン表に未掲載。付属の醤油の種類を要確認。Not on the published chart; the tuna hand-roll elsewhere on this menu contains wheat via smoked soy, so ask which soy comes with the set.

items.ja: 車海老の味噌漬け焼き
items.en: Tiger prawn marinated in miso and grilled crisp — shell, head and all, eaten whole
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」（麦味噌ではない）。Chart clears barley, i.e. the marinade is not 麦味噌.

items.ja: 甘〜い淡路熟成玉ねぎ
items.en: Aged Awaji onion — sweet, soft, almost no bite — grilled and salted
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（ろく助の塩）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Only the salt carries a fish flag — ask about it for vegan.

items.ja: 熟成紅はるかバター
items.en: Aged Beniharuka sweet potato cooked slowly to candy sweetness, topped with a soy-derived 'butter'
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。バターは大豆由来と店が明記。Chart shows nothing flagged and the shop states the butter is 大豆由来 (soy-derived) — so it is plant-based despite the name.

items.ja: 蓮根醤油焼き
items.en: Lotus root griddled with the house gluten-free soy — still crunchy
items.note: 店が「グルテンフリーの醤油で香ばしく」と明記、アレルゲン表も14品目「該当なし」。Shop states the gluten-free soy by name and the chart flags nothing.

items.ja: 本鮪の手巻き（やま幸鮪の手巻き）
items.en: Hand-roll of raw Yamayuki bluefin with freshly grated wasabi, in smoked-nori vinegar rice
items.note: 店が商品説明に「※グルテンが入っています」と明記、アレルゲン表も燻製醤油による小麦を表示。The shop itself prints 'contains gluten' on this one item and the chart confirms wheat via the 燻製醤油 (smoked soy). The single deliberate exception on an otherwise wheat-free menu — do not assume, read the line.

items.ja: とろタク手巻き
items.en: Roughly chopped Yamayuki chutoro with takuan pickle in a hand-roll — the item the shop's Instagram is built on
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ（海苔に海老・蟹コンタミ表示）、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat — unlike the tuna hand-roll directly above it, which does not. Read carefully.

items.ja: 尾崎牛と生雲丹
items.en: One-bite sushi pairing Ozaki beef with raw sea urchin
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介・牛のみ、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.ja: 生雲丹の手巻き
items.en: Toyosu-market raw sea urchin heaped into a hand-roll
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介のみ、小麦「該当なし」。Chart clears wheat.

items.ja: 開運一期大福
items.en: Wrapped in front of you: mochi and kibi-sugar bean paste from Nishi-Ogikubo's Echigo Tsuruya, around a seasonal fruit
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。Chart shows all fourteen 該当なし — so no wheat starch in the mochi, which is not a given. Ask whether the anko uses dairy before calling it vegan.

items.ja: とろけるわらび餅
items.en: Kneaded to order from real warabi and lotus starch, with house Okinawan brown-sugar syrup and kinako
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：14品目すべて「該当なし」。本わらび粉・蓮粉・黒糖・きな粉のみ。Chart flags nothing; ingredients are bracken starch, lotus starch, black sugar and soy flour. Most cheap warabimochi is potato-starch-and-wheat — this one is not.

items.ja: 抹茶のアフォガード
items.en: Yame matcha from Fukuoka whisked at your table and poured over thick matcha ice cream
items.section: 罪悪感のないスイーツ Guilt-free sweets
items.note: アレルゲン表：胡桃（ヌガー）・乳（アイス）あり、小麦「該当なし」。Chart flags walnut in the nougat and dairy in the ice cream but no wheat. Not vegan.

items.ja: 本日の土鍋ご飯 炊き込みご飯（きのこ）
items.romaji: honjitsu no donabe gohan — takikomi gohan (kinoko)
items.en: A rice-bowl portion of the day's clay-pot rice — mushrooms cooked into the rice with aged bonito dashi. Add 漬物 pickles +¥330 or salmon and smoked daikon +¥880
items.note: アレルゲン表：魚介（鰹出汁）のみ、小麦・大麦「該当なし」。自家製のタレもグルテンフリー。Chart flags fish stock only; the seasoning tare is the house gluten-free soy.

items.ja: 更科天狐コース
items.en: Eight courses: roast sobagaki, the five-piece sobamae platter, seared Ozaki beef tartare, the day's sashimi, kitsune-yaki, miso-grilled tiger prawn, shoyu-koji chicken, then your choice of sarashina or juwari soba, finishing with matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,600／飲み放題付き ¥8,000
items.note: コース中の蕎麦前盛り合わせのみアレルゲン表で大麦（山ウニ）「入っている」。他の構成品は小麦・大麦「該当なし」。Every course dish is cleared of wheat and barley by the shop's chart EXCEPT the sobamae platter, which carries barley via 山ウニ — ask them to substitute it. Two guests minimum, two-hour seating, 75-minute drink package.

items.ja: 特上牛タンしゃぶしゃぶコース
items.en: Six courses building to beef-tongue shabu-shabu, with the finishing soba and matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,000／飲み放題付き ¥7,500
items.note: 同じく蕎麦前盛り合わせに大麦。Same barley caveat on the included sobamae platter — ask for a substitution; everything else is chart-clear.

items.ja: 和牛ミスジしゃぶしゃぶコース
items.en: Six courses building to misuji wagyu shabu-shabu, with the finishing soba and matcha affogato
items.price: お料理のみ ¥6,600／飲み放題付き ¥8,000
items.note: 同じく蕎麦前盛り合わせに大麦。Same barley caveat on the included sobamae platter.

items.note: ライスペーパーは米粉だが、つけダレ（スイートチリ／ピーナッツ）に小麦や魚醤が入りうる。The rice paper is rice flour, which makes this the most plausible gluten-free starter — but the dipping sauce is the risk, and the filling may contain prawn or pork. Ask about both.

items.ja: カイ・チアオ・ムー・サップ（豚挽肉入りタイ風オムレツ）
items.en: Thai omelette with minced pork — fried hard so the edges puff and crisp, eaten over rice
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: 卵と豚肉、味付けはナンプラー。Egg and pork; fish sauce in the mix.

items.ja: 鶏粗挽き肉のイサン風料理（アラカルト）
items.en: Coarse-minced chicken, Isan style — the à la carte portion
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。No Thai name published for this à la carte listing. Fish sauce.

items.ja: トート・マン・プラー（タイ風さつま揚げ）
items.en: Thai fish cakes — red-curry-paste fish paste, bouncy and deep-fried, with cucumber relish
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: すり身のつなぎに小麦粉、揚げ油も共用。Fish-cake paste is bound with wheat flour and this comes out of a shared fryer.

items.ja: プラー・ラート・プリック（揚げ魚のスパイシーあんかけ）
items.en: A whole fish deep-fried and buried in sweet, sour, garlicky chilli sauce
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: 揚げ衣とあんのとろみに小麦粉、タレにも醤油。Wheat in the coating and usually in the thickened sauce, plus soy.

items.ja: ガイ・ヤーン（鶏もも肉のバーベキュー）
items.en: Grilled chicken thigh marinated in the shop's own sauce — Isan street-grill food
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: マリネ液にシーユー（タイ醤油）やオイスターソースが使われるのが一般的。Thai grill marinades usually contain soy and often oyster sauce — both wheat risks. Ask.

items.ja: コー・ムー・ヤーン（豚のど肉のあぶり焼き）
items.en: Grilled pork neck, sliced, with a sharp jaew dipping sauce
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: マリネ液・タレに醤油系調味料。Soy-family seasonings in the marinade and dip — ask.

items.ja: エビの網焼き
items.en: Grilled prawns
items.section: 前菜 アラカルト Appetiser — à la carte
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。つけダレの内容を要確認。No Thai name published; the dipping sauce is the wheat risk.

items.ja: パックブン・ファイデーン（空芯菜炒め）
items.en: Morning glory flash-fried over a roaring flame with garlic and chilli — the stalks stay squeaky
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: タオチオ（発酵大豆）・オイスターソース・ナンプラーが定番の味付け。Looks like the vegetarian option and often is not: the standard seasoning is fermented soybean plus oyster sauce and fish sauce. Oyster sauce is a common wheat carrier. Ask for both — a plain garlic-and-chilli version is usually possible.

items.ja: クン・ガティアム（エビのにんにく風味炒め）
items.en: Prawns stir-fried hard with garlic and white pepper
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: 醤油・オイスターソースを使うことが多い。Soy and oyster sauce likely — ask.

items.ja: プーニム・パッ・プリック・タイダム（ソフトシェルクラブの黒胡椒炒め）
items.romaji: poo nim pad prik thai dam
items.en: Soft-shell crab stir-fried in black pepper — you eat the shell and all
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: ソフトシェルクラブは小麦粉をまぶして揚げるのが一般的、ソースにも醤油。The crab is normally dusted in wheat flour and fried before the sauce goes on.

items.ja: ナスのガパオ炒め
items.en: Aubergine stir-fried with holy basil in the gapao style
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。ガパオ炒めの基本はオイスターソース・シーユー・ナンプラー。No Thai name published. Gapao seasoning is built on oyster sauce, Thai soy and fish sauce, so the vegetable version is neither automatically vegan nor automatically wheat-free — ask specifically.

items.ja: プーニム・パッポン・カリー（ソフトシェルクラブの玉子カレー炒め）
items.en: Soft-shell crab in the yellow curry-and-egg stir-fry — rich, mild, meant for rice
items.section: メイン 炒め物 Main — stir-fries
items.note: 小麦粉をまぶした揚げカニ＋卵。Wheat-dusted crab plus egg.

items.ja: ガパオ・ガイ・ラート・カーオ（鶏肉のガパオごはん）
items.en: The dish the shop is named after: chicken and holy basil stir-fried and poured over rice, deliberately soupier than most versions. The basil is always fresh, never dried, and the shop makes a point of it
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 「コダワリの複数調味料」＝オイスターソース・シーユー・ナンプラーの併用が想定される。The shop's own description boasts of a multi-sauce seasoning blend, which in practice means oyster sauce and Thai soy — wheat risks — plus fish sauce. Usually topped with a fried egg. Ask.

items.ja: ガパオ・ムー・ラート・カーオ（豚肉のガパオごはん）
items.en: The same gapao over rice, made with pork
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 同じ調味料構成。Same sauce base — ask.

items.ja: ガパオ・ヌア・ラート・カーオ（牛肉のガパオごはん）
items.en: Gapao over rice made with beef
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 同じ調味料構成。

items.ja: ガパオ・タレー・ラート・カーオ（シーフードのガパオごはん）
items.en: Gapao over rice with mixed seafood
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 同じ調味料構成。

items.ja: カーオ・パッ・クン（エビチャーハン）
items.en: Prawn fried rice, finished fast over a high flame
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 醤油・ナンプラーで味付け。Seasoned with soy and fish sauce — ask about the soy.

items.ja: カーオ・トム・クン（エビのお粥）
items.en: Prawn rice soup — a loose, comforting rice porridge, the Thai hangover cure
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: 出汁とナンプラー。Stock and fish sauce.

items.ja: カオマンガイ（蒸し鶏のせライス）
items.en: Poached chicken on rice cooked in the chicken stock with plenty of ginger and garlic, served with the shop's own hot sauce to spoon over
items.section: メイン ごはんもの Main — rice dishes
items.note: カオマンガイのタレはタオチオ（発酵大豆）とシーユーが基本＝小麦の可能性大。The sauce that makes this dish is fermented soybean and Thai soy, which is exactly where the wheat would be. Ask, or ask for it without the sauce.

items.ja: ゲーン・マッサマン（マッサマンカレー）
items.en: Massaman — the southern Thai curry with coconut milk, potato, peanut and the sour note of tamarind. Mild. CNN once called it the best dish in the world and the shop has not stopped mentioning it
items.section: メイン カレー Main — curries
items.note: カレーペーストにエビペースト（カピ）、仕上げにナンプラー。Thai curry pastes contain shrimp paste and the finish is fish sauce, so not vegan. Usually wheat-free, but ask.

items.ja: ゲーン・キアオ・ガイ（鶏肉のグリーンカレー）
items.en: Green curry with chicken — chicken stock, green chilli heat and Thai sweet basil (horapha) against coconut sweetness
items.section: メイン カレー Main — curries
items.note: ペーストにカピ（エビペースト）、ナンプラーで調味。Shrimp paste in the curry paste, fish sauce in the seasoning.

items.ja: ゲーン・ペット・クン（エビのレッドカレー）
items.en: Red curry with prawns
items.section: メイン カレー Main — curries
items.note: 同上。Same shrimp-paste and fish-sauce base.

items.ja: タイ風汁そば
items.en: Thai noodle soup — rice noodles in broth
items.section: メイン 麺類 Main — noodles
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。米麺だが、スープに醤油系調味料が入るのが一般的。Thai noodles are rice, which is promising, but the broth is normally seasoned with soy — ask.

items.ja: タイ風汁そば（トムヤムスープ）
items.en: Thai noodle soup in tom yum broth — hot and sour
items.section: メイン 麺類 Main — noodles
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。No Thai name published. Rice noodles; fish sauce and possibly soy in the broth.

items.ja: タイ風焼きそば（パッタイ）
items.en: Pad thai — flat rice noodles fried with tamarind, egg, bean sprouts and crushed peanut
items.section: メイン 麺類 Main — noodles
items.note: 米麺は小麦不使用だが、パッタイソースに醤油・エビが入るのが定番。The noodles are rice, but pad thai sauce standardly carries soy and dried shrimp, and the dish contains egg. Ask.

items.ja: トムヤムクン（エビのトムヤムスープ）
items.en: Tom yum kung — prawn soup sharp with lemongrass, galangal, lime leaf and chilli
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: ナンプラー、ペーストにカピ。Fish sauce and shrimp paste.

items.ja: トムカーガイ（鶏肉のココナツミルクスープ）
items.en: Tom kha gai — chicken in a coconut-milk soup mellowed with galangal
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: タイ語名は店の英語表記に基づく一般名。ナンプラー使用。Fish sauce.

items.ja: 豆腐と春雨のさっぱりスープ
items.en: A clear, light soup with tofu and glass noodles — the gentlest thing on the menu
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。タイの澄ましスープは豚だしとナンプラーが基本。No Thai name published. Thai clear soups are normally pork stock with fish sauce — this is not the vegetarian dish it looks like unless the kitchen confirms it. Ask.

items.ja: シーフードのトムヤムスープ
items.en: Tom yum with mixed seafood
items.section: メイン スープ Main — soups
items.note: タイ語名は未公開。No Thai name published. Fish sauce and shrimp paste.

items.ja: タピオカ・ココナツミルク
items.en: Tapioca pearls in coconut milk
items.note: タピオカはキャッサバでんぷんで小麦不使用。ココナツミルクベースなら乳製品不使用。Tapioca is cassava starch, so wheat-free, and coconut milk means no dairy — this is the most likely vegan and gluten-free dessert here, but the shop publishes nothing, so ask.

items.ja: タロイモのタイ風プリン
items.en: Thai-style taro pudding
items.note: タイのプリンは卵や小麦粉を使うものもある。Some Thai puddings use egg or wheat flour — ask.

items.ja: ココナツプリン
items.en: Coconut pudding
items.note: ゼラチンか寒天か未公開。Set with gelatine or agar — not stated, which matters for vegan. Ask.

items.ja: もち米の温かいおもち
items.en: Warm sticky-rice sweet
items.note: もち米は小麦不使用。Sticky rice is wheat-free in itself; the accompaniments are not published.

items.ja: タロイモともち米の温かいデザート
items.en: Warm taro and sticky-rice dessert
items.note: 同上。Same — ask.

items.ja: イサーンコース
items.en: A course of northeastern Isan dishes — the shop's popular one. With two hours of all-you-can-drink including draught beer, ¥4,980
items.note: 飲み放題に生ビール＝麦芽。The drink package includes draught beer, which is malt. Course contents are not itemised on the site — ask when booking if you have a restriction.

items.ja: 定番コース
items.en: The classic course — the popular starters and the Thai standards. With two hours of all-you-can-drink including draught beer, ¥5,980
items.note: 同上、内容は未公開。Contents not itemised.

items.ja: 特別プランコース（全8品）
items.en: Eight courses built from the à la carte greatest hits. With the drink package, ¥5,480
items.note: 内容は未公開。Contents not itemised.

items.ja: お弁当（テイクアウト）
items.en: Takeaway bento sold at the counter every day, from ¥600, with delivery and a subscription option
items.note: 内容は日替わり。Contents change daily; Uber Eats delivery is also offered.

tokyo_oiwake_dango_honpo_shinj.price_note: Every price and every allergen note comes from the shop's own site — the 喫茶室 (tearoom) page for the eat-in sets and one product page per skewer for the counter prices. Prices tax-included as printed. Counter sales 10:30–19:00; tearoom weekdays 12:00–18:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–18:00, L.O. 17:30, no seat reservations. The site still carries a 2022 COVID notice suspending the tearoom, but it is commented out in the page source and a 2026-04-29 shop announcement reopened the summer shaved-ice service in the tearoom — the tearoom is running. Shop closes when the day's dango sell out.

items.ja: だんご２本盛
items.en: Two skewers of your choice, plated with tea in the tearoom — the standard order
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: 選んだ串によって小麦の有無が変わる（みたらし・生醤油・のり系・胡麻たれは小麦、あん系は表示なし）。Whether this is wheat-free depends entirely on which two skewers you pick: the shop's own allergen lines flag 小麦 on the mitarashi, kijoyu, nori and sesame skewers but list no allergens at all on the bean-paste ones. Choose こしあん / 小倉 / 白あん / きなこあん / 抹茶あん / よもぎ and it is a different dish allergen-wise. Ask about dashi in the tea service for vegan.

items.ja: あんみつ（喫茶）
items.en: Anmitsu — cubes of Amakusa agar jelly with the house red bean paste, Hokkaido red peas and seasonal fruit, under Okinawan brown-sugar syrup you pour yourself
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: 商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。Neither the tearoom page nor the anmitsu product page lists any allergen, unlike the soy-glazed skewers which are explicitly flagged 小麦. Agar, beans, fruit and black-sugar syrup are all plant and wheat-free by nature — but the shop has not stated it, so ask rather than assume.

items.ja: 田舎しるこ
items.en: Country-style red bean soup, restrained in sweetness so the azuki flavour comes through, with a piece of mochi toasted until it blisters. In summer it becomes chilled shiruko with shiratama dumplings instead
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: 商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged by the shop. Azuki, sugar and rice mochi carry no wheat inherently — ask to be sure, and note the summer version swaps the grilled mochi for shiratama.

items.ja: 味の散歩（みたらしだんご・あんみつ・ところてん）
items.en: 'A stroll of flavours' — a tray of three small bowls: a mitarashi skewer, anmitsu, and tokoroten (chilled agar noodles). The tearoom's most-ordered set
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: みたらしだんごは店の表示で特定原材料「小麦」。ところてんの三杯酢も通常は醤油ベース。The mitarashi skewer in this set is flagged 小麦 by the shop itself, and the tokoroten vinegar dressing is normally soy-based too. Not gluten-free as served.

items.ja: 田舎小路（みたらしだんご・あんみつ・田舎しるこ）
items.en: Three of the house sweets on one tray: a mitarashi skewer, anmitsu and the country shiruko. In summer the shiruko becomes the chilled version with shiratama
items.section: 喫茶 定番メニュー Tearoom — regular
items.note: みたらしだんごに「小麦」表示あり。The mitarashi skewer is flagged 小麦 by the shop.

items.ja: かき氷（氷抹茶・いちご・きなこ・氷あずき）
items.romaji: kakigori — kori matcha / ichigo / kinako / kori azuki
items.en: Summer shaved ice, served in the tearoom: Nishio matcha with its refined bitterness, strawberry, kinako soy flour, and 'kori azuki' under the shop's own zenzai bean paste
items.section: 喫茶 季節限定 Tearoom — seasonal
items.note: 価格は店頭表示のみ。2026年4月29日開始の告知あり。The shop announced the 2026 shaved-ice season on 29 April 2026 but publishes no prices — read the tearoom board. Expect queues at busy times. Ask about condensed milk on the strawberry version for vegan.

items.ja: みたらし
items.en: The best-seller: rice dango lacquered in the house sweet-savoury glaze, thick enough to cling
items.note: 店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。The shop's own product page states 小麦 (wheat) — the glaze is soy-based. Explicit allergen labelling from the shop itself, which is rare and worth trusting.

items.ja: 大人のみたらし
items.en: 'Grown-up mitarashi' — the same glaze blended with sansho pepper and fresh shichimi, so it prickles
items.note: 店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。Shop states 小麦.

items.ja: 生醤油
items.en: Grilled plain in a mellow soy sauce steeped with gagome kombu — savoury, not sweet
items.note: 店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記（醤油由来）。Shop states 小麦 — from the soy sauce.

items.ja: のり巻
items.en: The kijoyu dango wrapped in nori — a long-standing favourite here
items.note: 店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。Shop states 小麦.

items.ja: のり七味
items.en: The nori-wrapped dango dusted with Naito shichimi — the seven-spice grown in Edo-era Naito-Shinjuku, right here. Renewed September 2024
items.note: 店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。Shop states 小麦.

items.ja: 内藤七味だんご
items.en: Loaded with Naito shichimi, Shinjuku's own historic seven-spice — properly hot
items.note: 店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。Shop states 小麦.

items.ja: 胡麻たれ
items.en: Under a thick black sesame sauce
items.note: 店の商品ページが特定原材料「小麦」と明記。Shop states 小麦 — the sesame sauce is soy-seasoned.

items.ja: こしあん
items.en: Under smooth strained Hokkaido azuki paste, kept deliberately light on sugar
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし（みたらし等には「小麦」表示があるため、無表示は意味を持つ）。The shop flags 小麦 on every soy-glazed skewer but flags nothing on this one — an informative silence, since the same site does label. Rice dango and bean paste contain no wheat inherently. Still worth confirming at the counter.

items.ja: 小倉
items.en: Under chunky tsubu-an so you get whole beans
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged by the shop, unlike the glazed skewers — see the koshian note.

items.ja: 白あん
items.en: Under white bean paste made from white kidney beans — mellow and less sweet
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged by the shop.

items.ja: きなこあん
items.en: Bean paste dusted with domestic kinako roasted soy flour
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。きなこは大豆。No allergen flagged. Kinako is soy, not a cereal.

items.ja: 抹茶あん
items.en: Under a deep matcha bean paste made with Nishio matcha
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged.

items.ja: よもぎ（つぶあん）
items.en: Mugwort dango, green and grassy, under chunky bean paste
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。※機械の故障のため当面休止中との掲示あり。No allergen flagged — but the shop's product page also carries a notice that this one is suspended for the time being because of a machine breakdown. Check before you plan around it.

items.ja: よもぎ（こしあん）
items.en: Mugwort dango under smooth strained bean paste
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged.

items.ja: あんみつ（お持ち帰り）
items.en: Anmitsu to take away — the Amakusa agar, the house paste and the black-sugar syrup, boxed
items.section: あんみつ・赤飯 Anmitsu & sekihan (counter)
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。抹茶あんみつや季節のあんみつもあり。No allergen flagged. Matcha anmitsu and seasonal versions are also sold.

items.ja: 豆かん
items.en: Mamekan — agar cubes and plump Hokkaido red peas, with syrup and no bean paste. The austere, salty-sweet Tokyo original that anmitsu was built on
items.section: あんみつ・赤飯 Anmitsu & sekihan (counter)
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。寒天・赤えんどう・黒みつのみの構成。No allergen flagged; the composition is agar, peas and syrup only, which is about as simple as a Japanese sweet gets.

items.ja: 赤飯
items.en: Red rice — domestic glutinous rice steamed with sasage beans, cooked fresh every morning. Celebratory food, sold plain by the box
items.section: あんみつ・赤飯 Anmitsu & sekihan (counter)
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。もち米とささげ豆のみ。No allergen flagged; the shop names only glutinous rice and sasage beans. Ask about the goma-shio topping if you need certainty.

items.ja: あんず大福（夏）
items.en: Summer only: apricot bean paste with pieces of the fruit, wrapped in mochi — tart against the sweetness
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged.

items.ja: 梅みょうが（夏〜秋）
items.en: Summer into autumn: a dango scorched on the grill and topped with honeyed Nanko plum and fresh myoga ginger. The shop's most unusual skewer
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged.

items.ja: 栗大福（秋）／栗あん（秋〜冬）
items.en: Autumn: chestnut daifuku with a whole chestnut inside (¥453); autumn into winter, a chestnut-paste skewer topped with a large chestnut (¥453)
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged.

items.ja: ゆずあん（秋〜冬）
items.en: Autumn into winter: a fragrant yuzu bean paste
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged.

items.ja: いちご大福／いちごあん（冬〜春）
items.en: Winter into spring: strawberry daifuku, a whole domestic strawberry in mochi (¥410 — currently made with white bean paste and Tochiaika berries), and a strawberry-paste skewer (¥432)
items.price: 大福 税込410円／あん 税込432円
items.note: 店の商品ページに特定原材料の表示なし。No allergen flagged.

items.ja: 桜餅／草餅／桜あんだんご／菜の花（春）
items.romaji: sakura mochi / kusa mochi / sakura-an dango / nanohana (haru)
items.en: Spring: sakura mochi, kusa mochi with domestic mugwort around tsubu-an (¥302), a cherry-blossom paste skewer, and a nanohana skewer topped with rapeseed greens simmered in fragrant dashi (¥345)
items.price: 草餅 税込302円／菜の花 税込345円
items.note: 菜の花は「香り豊かな出汁で炊いた」＝鰹だしの可能性が高くヴィーガン不可。桜餅の葉は塩漬け。The nanohana skewer is simmered in dashi, which almost certainly means bonito — not vegan. The shop flags no allergens on these pages. Spring items sell only in season and the shop suspends sakura-mochi and kusa-mochi for a few days in March to make ohagi.

items.ja: はちみつレモン（初夏）
items.en: Early summer: a lemon paste made with Setouchi lemons, topped with syrup-steeped lemon eaten peel and all
items.note: はちみつ使用のためヴィーガン不可。Contains honey, so not vegan. No allergen flagged by the shop.

items.ja: 豆大福／豆餅
items.en: Wagashi counter: bean daifuku and plain bean mochi, studded with whole beans
items.note: 店のサイトは品名のみで価格・アレルゲンを公開していない。The shop lists these by name only — no price and no allergen line on the site. Read the counter card.

tokyo_kokusai_hiyoukan.price_note: Read at full resolution from photographs of the shop's own order slip (メニュー兼注文票) dated 2026-07, cross-checked against the 2026-03 Japanese and English versions of the same slip and the painted street A-board. Prices as printed. IMPORTANT: this is the LUNCH ramen operation only — the red A-board reads 【昼限定】昔ながらの博多豚骨 ¥1,000, 11:00〜14:00. At night the same room is a Hokkaido jingisukan (grilled-lamb) izakaya, with an entirely separate menu and a ¥500 otoshi table charge; its prices are not published anywhere reachable and are not listed here. You order by circling items on the slip and writing your own total.

items.ja: 豚骨ラーメン
items.en: The lunch bowl: an old-style Hakata tonkotsu — thin straight noodles in a milky pork-bone broth. One kaedama (noodle refill) is free, and the counter expects you to use it
items.note: 細麺は小麦、豚骨スープにも醤油・タレ。Hakata noodles are wheat and the tare is soy-based. Pork broth. Choose your noodle firmness on the slip: バリカタ 20 sec / かため 30 / ふつう 40 / ちょいやわ 50 / やわめ 60.

items.ja: 月見ラーメン
items.en: The tonkotsu with a raw egg dropped in
items.note: 麺＝小麦、卵あり。Wheat noodles plus raw egg.

items.ja: 味玉ラーメン
items.en: The tonkotsu with a marinated soft-boiled egg
items.note: 味玉の漬け地は醤油＝小麦。The marinated egg is steeped in soy, so wheat twice over.

items.ja: 特製ラーメン
items.en: The loaded bowl — the shop's recommendation. Comes with rock nori, wakame and the tsukimi egg on top; swap the raw egg for a marinated one for ¥100 more
items.note: 店の注記：「岩のり・わかめ・月見が乗っています。味玉は+100で変更できます」。麺・タレとも小麦。The shop's own note explains the toppings. Wheat noodles and soy tare.

items.ja: 海苔玉ラーメン
items.en: Ramen with rock nori and egg — listed on the 2026-03 slip as 'Ramen with Seaweed and Egg'
items.note: 2026年3月の注文票に掲載。2026年7月の票では特製ラーメンに統合されている。On the March 2026 slip; the July 2026 slip folds this into 特製ラーメン. Wheat noodles.

items.ja: 肉ワカメラーメン
items.en: Ramen with extra chashu and wakame seaweed — 'Ramen with Meat and Wakame Seaweed' on the shop's own English slip
items.note: 2026年3月の注文票に掲載。チャーシューの煮汁も醤油。On the March 2026 slip. The chashu braise is soy-based.

items.ja: 特製月見ラーメン
items.en: The loaded bowl with the raw egg; +¥100 converts it to a soft salted egg
items.note: 2026年3月の注文票に掲載、「+100円で半熟塩卵に変更できます」。On the March 2026 slip with the shop's note about upgrading to the 半熟塩卵.

items.ja: 豚骨ミニカレー
items.en: A small curry made by cooking spices into the pork-bone broth — the shop flags it as recommended, and it is the thing regulars add to the ramen
items.note: 店の注記：「豚骨で炊いた特製スパイスカレーです」。日本のカレーは小麦粉のルウが一般的で、豚骨ベース。The shop's own note calls it a spice curry cooked in tonkotsu. Japanese curry is normally roux-thickened with wheat, and this one is built on pork broth either way.

items.ja: カレーライス
items.en: Full-size curry rice
items.note: 2026年3月の注文票に掲載。ルウは小麦粉、豚骨ベース。On the March 2026 slip. Wheat roux, pork base.

items.ja: 白ごはん／ライス
items.en: Plain white rice — ¥100 on the July 2026 slip, ¥200 on the March one
items.note: 白米のみ。Plain steamed rice with nothing on it — the only wheat-free, animal-free thing on the lunch slip. The price moved between the two dated slips, so read the card.

items.ja: 替え玉（2回目）
items.en: Noodle refill — the first one is free, the second costs this. Say 'kaedama, please' and hold onto some broth
items.note: 麺は小麦。Hakata-style wheat noodles.

items.ja: 半替え玉（2回目）
items.en: Half-portion noodle refill
items.note: 麺は小麦。

items.ja: ネギ増し
items.en: Extra spring onion
items.note: 生ネギのみ。Raw spring onion only — no seasoning, no wheat, no animal product. (It goes into a wheat bowl, but the topping itself is clean.)

items.ja: キクラゲ増し
items.en: Extra wood-ear mushroom — the crunchy black strands that define a Hakata bowl
items.note: キクラゲの味付け（醤油・ごま油）が一般的。Wood-ear is usually pre-seasoned with soy and sesame oil — ask.

items.ja: 岩海苔
items.en: Rock nori — the shop marks this one as recommended
items.note: 岩のりの佃煮風味付けに醤油を使う場合がある。Rock nori is sometimes served plain and sometimes soy-simmered — ask which.

items.ja: 生わかめ
items.en: Fresh wakame seaweed — also marked recommended
items.note: 生わかめのみで調味なし。Plain fresh wakame, no seasoning.

items.ja: もやし増し
items.en: Extra bean sprouts
items.note: 2026年3月の注文票に掲載。もやしのみ。On the March 2026 slip. Plain sprouts.

items.ja: 肉増し
items.en: Extra chashu pork
items.note: チャーシューの煮汁は醤油＝小麦。Chashu is braised in soy.

items.ja: 味玉
items.en: Marinated soft-boiled egg
items.note: 漬け地は醤油＝小麦。Soy marinade.

items.ja: 半熟塩卵
items.en: Soft-boiled salt-cured egg — the salt version rather than the soy one
items.note: 2026年3月の注文票に掲載。「塩」表記だが漬け地の詳細は未公表。On the March 2026 slip. Salt-cured rather than soy-cured, which is promising — but the cure is not itemised, so ask.

items.ja: 生卵
items.en: Raw egg
items.note: 生卵のみ、調味なし。A plain raw egg — no seasoning, so no wheat. Not vegan.

items.ja: 夜の部：北海道ジンギスカン（羊肉）
items.en: Evenings the room becomes a Hokkaido lamb restaurant — the wall boards advertise 'THE KINDAN RAMU' grilled lamb, a vegetable set, kimchi, draught beer, Akaboshi bottled lager, IPA, fresh lemon sour and umeboshi sour. A ¥500 otoshi (cover) applies in the evening but not at ramen lunch
items.note: 価格は店内掲示のみで公開情報なし。ジンギスカンのタレは醤油・果物ベース＝小麦、ビール類は麦芽。No evening prices are published anywhere reachable — this entry records that the evening operation exists and is a different restaurant in the same room, so you can see the ramen slip and still be handed a lamb menu at 18:00. Jingisukan dipping sauce is soy-and-fruit based, i.e. wheat, and every beer listed is malt.

tokyo_atacu_cafe.price_note: Read at full resolution from photographs of the shop's own handwritten Lunch and Drink boards. The board was photographed in 2024-03, 2024-04 and again in 2025-12 with identical figures, so these prices have held for two years and are current. Every lunch comes with soup, a small side dish and dessert. Take the same lunch away as a bento and it is ¥200 less.

items.ja: 旅するタコライス（Japan テリヤキ／Korea コチュジャン／Mexico シーザー／Thai チリ）
items.en: 'Taco rice that travels' — the Okinawan taco-rice bowl reworked four ways, and you pick the country: Japan (teriyaki), Korea (gochujang), Mexico (Caesar) or Thai (chilli). Comes with soup, a small side and dessert
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: テリヤキは醤油＝小麦、コチュジャンも小麦麹を含むのが一般的、シーザードレッシングはアンチョビ・卵・乳。Teriyaki is soy, so wheat; Korean gochujang is normally fermented with wheat; Caesar dressing carries anchovy, egg and dairy. The Thai chilli version is the only one with a chance — ask.

items.ja: スシボウル（マグロとろたく＋ワサビマヨソース）
items.romaji: sushi bowl (maguro torotaku + wasabi mayo sauce)
items.en: Sushi bowl — chopped tuna with takuan pickle under a wasabi mayonnaise
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ワサビマヨは卵、寿司飯や添え醤油に小麦の可能性。Wasabi mayo means egg; the rice seasoning and any soy served alongside are the wheat risk — ask.

items.ja: キーマカレー（辛さレベル1〜10）
items.en: Keema curry, with the heat set anywhere from 1 to 10 — say a number when you order
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: スパイスから作るキーマならルウ不要だが、店は原材料を公開していない。A from-scratch keema needs no wheat roux, unlike a Japanese curry — but this shop publishes no ingredients, so ask whether flour or a commercial roux goes in. Minced meat.

items.ja: グリーンサラダボウル（おにぎり or トースト付）
items.romaji: green salad bowl (onigiri or toast tsuki)
items.en: Green salad bowl, served with either a rice ball or toast — choose the onigiri and the plate changes character entirely
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: トーストは小麦。おにぎりを選べば小麦回避の可能性があるが、ドレッシングと具材は未公開。Pick toast and it is wheat; pick the onigiri and it may not be — but the dressing and the rice-ball filling are not published, so ask. Dressings commonly carry soy sauce or dairy.

items.ja: オムライス
items.en: Omurice — the shop's board carries a handwritten apology that ingredient costs forced the price up
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: 店の手書き注記：「材料が高くなっている為、値上げしました。すみません」。ケチャップライスに使うウスターソースやデミグラスは小麦、卵あり。Omurice sauces (Worcester, demi-glace, or a soy-spiked ketchup rice) are wheat-based, and the dish is wrapped in egg.

items.ja: なんでもリクエストオーダー（パスタ・ドリアなどなど）
items.en: Request anything — the board invites you to ask for pasta, doria or whatever else, at market price. Currently marked 'coming soon'
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ボードに「coming soon」の付箋あり。パスタ・ドリアはいずれも小麦。The board has a 'coming soon' sticker over part of this line, so it may not be running. Pasta and doria are both wheat — but a request-anything policy is exactly the opening a restricted diet needs. Worth asking in person.

items.ja: 煮込みハンバーグ ビーフシチュー
items.en: Hamburg steak simmered in beef stew. Currently marked 'coming soon' on the board
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ボードに「coming soon」の付箋あり。デミグラス／シチューのルウは小麦、ハンバーグのつなぎはパン粉。Marked coming soon. Stew roux is wheat and the patty binder is panko.

items.ja: ランチドリンク（ICEコーヒー／ICEティー）
items.en: Add an iced coffee or iced tea to any lunch
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ブラックであれば植物性。Plant-only if taken black. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: お弁当テイクアウト
items.en: Take any lunch away as a bento and it is ¥200 cheaper
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: 同じ料理の持ち帰り。Same dishes, boxed. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 竹炭ドリップコーヒー
items.en: Bamboo-charcoal drip coffee — the café's signature, filtered through bamboo charcoal
items.note: コーヒーのみ。Black coffee. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: 竹炭アメリカーノ
items.en: Bamboo-charcoal americano
items.note: Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.en: Café latte
items.note: 牛乳使用。Dairy milk; plant-milk substitution is not advertised — ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: カプチーノ（ストレート／キャラメル／チョコ）
items.en: Cappuccino — plain, caramel or chocolate
items.note: 牛乳使用。Dairy. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: ニルギリ産紅茶
items.en: Nilgiri black tea from southern India
items.note: 茶葉のみ。Straight tea leaf — not a barley tea. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: コールドブリューコーヒー
items.en: Cold brew coffee
items.note: No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: アイスラテ
items.en: Iced latte
items.note: 牛乳使用。Dairy. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: クリームラテ（ストレート／キャラメル／チョコ）
items.en: Cream latte — plain, caramel or chocolate
items.note: 生クリーム・牛乳。Cream and dairy milk. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: ニルギリ産アイスティー
items.en: Iced Nilgiri tea
items.note: Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.
