items.en: Iced chai
items.note: チャイは牛乳ベース。Chai is milk-based here; plant-milk is not advertised. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 本日のフルーツスムージー
items.en: The day's fruit smoothie
items.note: ヨーグルトや牛乳が入る場合あり、内容は日替わり。Smoothies often carry yoghurt or milk and the fruit changes daily — ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 本日のフルーツソーダ
items.en: The day's fruit soda
items.note: ボードに価格の記載なし（スムージーの¥700と並記されているが本品の価格線は空欄）。The board lists this line without its own price — the ¥700 sits against the smoothie above it. Read the board rather than assume the same figure. No wheat route in a soft drink.

tokyo_hayashi.price_note: Read from photographs of the shop's own bilingual window board and its ticket machine, both dated 2026-06 — the machine has exactly three live buttons and they match the board, so this is the whole menu. Cash only. Open 11:30–15:30 and closes the moment the soup runs out; shut Wednesdays and Sundays. The window also asks that children of primary-school age and under not be brought in. A Tabelog user card updated 2025-11 adds the off-menu 塩らーめん.

items.ja: らーめん
items.en: The bowl this counter has been famous for since the 1970s and which has made the Tabelog ramen Hyakumeiten list every year since 2017: a dark soy broth built on fish, dried shrimp, chicken and pork, with a heap of chopped raw onion on top. The onion is the point — do not push it aside
items.note: 店自らが掲示：「当店では魚介類・エビ・鶏肉・豚肉・醤油等の材料を使用しています」。醤油＝小麦、中華麺＝小麦。The shop posts its own allergy notice in the window naming fish, shrimp, chicken, pork and soy sauce — soy sauce means wheat, and the noodles are wheat too. That notice is unusually forthcoming for a ramen counter and is worth reading if you have a shellfish allergy.

items.ja: 味玉らーめん
items.en: The same bowl with a marinated soft-boiled egg
items.note: 麺・スープ・味玉の漬け地すべて醤油＝小麦。Wheat in the noodles, the broth and the egg marinade.

items.ja: 焼豚らーめん（味玉付き）
items.en: The bowl piled with chashu pork, marinated egg included
items.note: 焼豚の煮汁も醤油。The chashu braise is soy as well.

items.ja: 塩らーめん（裏メニュー）
items.en: The off-menu salt version. It is not on the ticket machine or the board: buy a normal ¥1,000 ticket, and when you hand it over say 塩味で (shio-aji de). No extra charge
items.note: 食べログの利用者登録メニュー（更新日2025/11/24）による裏メニュー。塩でも麺は小麦、スープのベースは同じ魚介・鶏・豚。Recorded on the shop's Tabelog page by a user (updated 2025-11-24), not by the shop — but the ordering instruction is specific enough to be worth carrying. Salt tare instead of soy, but the noodles are still wheat and the stock is the same fish-chicken-pork base.

tokyo_miyazaki_fu_do_quwanne.price_note: The lunch teishoku, the add-ons, the desserts and the soft drinks are read from photographs of the shop's own bound menu book dated 2026-07. The evening à la carte and courses come from the shop's Tabelog listing, updated 2026-08-03 — very recent, and written in the shop's own promotional voice, but registered rather than owner-verified, so treat those figures as strong rather than certain. Tax included. The restaurant is the 2F of 新宿みやざき館 KONNE, Miyazaki Prefecture's Tokyo showcase on Shinjuku Southern Terrace — the shop notes that supply may force substitutions and that not every ingredient is from Miyazaki. Open 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00).

items.ja: 冷や汁定食
items.en: Miyazaki's defining dish and the reason to come at lunch: cold miso-and-grilled-aji soup, thick with sesame, tofu, shiso, myoga and cucumber, poured over rice. Set includes two sashimi, a mini chicken nanban, rice, miso soup and pickles. Rice size S/M/L, large +¥50
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 冷や汁は麦味噌を使うのが宮崎の伝統で、麦＝グルテン。だしは鰹・鯵。加えてチキン南蛮は小麦衣。Hiyajiru in Miyazaki is traditionally made with 麦味噌 (barley miso), and barley is gluten — this is exactly the trap the dish sets. The stock is grilled horse mackerel and bonito, and the set includes a wheat-battered chicken nanban. Ask which miso if it matters.

items.ja: かつおめし定食
items.en: Bonito from Nichinan, cured in soy and sesame, eaten first straight over rice and then as chazuke with the dashi poured on — the fishing-town way. With a small side, a katsuobushi salad, rice and miso soup
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 漬け地は醤油＝小麦、出汁茶漬けの出汁も醤油系。The cure is soy sauce and the pouring dashi is soy-seasoned.

items.ja: “炭薫る”みやざき地頭鶏親子丼定食
items.romaji: sumi kaoru Miyazaki jitokko oyakodon teishoku
items.en: Oyakodon made with charcoal-grilled Miyazaki jitokko chicken, so the egg-and-chicken bowl carries smoke through it
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 親子丼の割下は醤油・味醂＝小麦、卵あり。Oyakodon simmering liquid is soy and mirin; contains egg. The shop notes the egg is not necessarily a jidori egg.

items.ja: ご飯大盛り
items.en: Upsize the rice on any teishoku
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 白米のみ。Plain rice.

items.ja: ちょいたし：刺身2種盛り
items.en: Lunch add-on: two kinds of sashimi, with the house sweet-soy sauce made from Miyazaki soy
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 宮崎の甘口醤油で作る自家製醤油餡＝小麦。The house sauce is built on Miyazaki's sweet soy sauce — wheat. Ask for salt if you need to avoid it; the fish itself is clean.

items.ja: ちょいたし：若鶏ミニチキン南蛮
items.en: Lunch add-on: a small chicken nanban — fried chicken in sweet vinegar under tartare sauce. Miyazaki invented the dish and this shop won gold in the national karaage grand prix for it
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 衣は小麦・卵、甘酢は醤油ベース、タルタルは卵・乳。Wheat batter, soy-based sweet vinegar, egg-and-dairy tartare. Nothing about chicken nanban is gluten-free.

items.ja: ちょいたし：みやざき地頭鶏むね身たたき
items.en: Lunch add-on: jitokko chicken breast seared outside, raw inside, sliced thin. The shop describes it as bouncy and full-flavoured
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: つけダレの内容は未表示。The dipping sauce is not itemised on the book — ask, since ponzu and soy are the usual accompaniments. Note this is raw chicken, served deliberately.

items.ja: ちょいたし：蔵の厚焼き卵焼き
items.en: Lunch add-on: the thick rolled omelette the shop compares to a custard pudding
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 写真では価格欄が読み取れず。À la carte it is ¥600; the add-on price was not legible in the photographed page, so it is left empty rather than guessed. Rolled omelette is normally seasoned with dashi and soy — ask.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏の炭火焼き
items.en: The dish Miyazaki is known for nationally: jitokko chicken — a slow-grown native breed raised four to five months — charred hard over charcoal so it comes out black, smoky and genuinely chewy
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 炭火焼きは塩のみの場合と醤油ダレの場合がある。Charcoal-grilled jitokko is often salt-only, which would make it one of the safer dishes here — but the shop does not say, and柚子胡椒 and soy are the usual partners. Ask for 塩のみ.

items.ja: 宮崎牛の炭火焼き
items.en: Charcoal-grilled Miyazaki beef — the brand requires Japanese Black cattle raised in the prefecture and graded 4 or above
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: つけダレ・味付けは未表示。Seasoning not published — ask for salt only.

items.ja: おいも豚の炭火焼
items.en: Charcoal-grilled 'sweet-potato pork' — pigs fed a blend of sweet potato and barley, which the shop says gives soft meat and sweet fat
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 餌に大麦を使うが、飼料の麦が肉のグルテンになるわけではない。味付けが未表示のため要確認。The barley is in the feed, not the meat — feed does not transfer gluten. The unknown is the seasoning, which is not published. Ask.

items.ja: ダブル南蛮
items.en: Gold medallist in the 11th national Karaage Grand Prix, chicken-nanban division: the young-chicken nanban served with a shiitake nanban alongside
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 衣は小麦・卵、甘酢は醤油、タルタルは卵・乳。Wheat batter, soy sweet-vinegar, egg-and-dairy tartare — and the shiitake half is battered the same way, so it is not the vegetarian escape it looks like.

items.ja: 鮮魚のお造り
items.en: Sashimi of the day's fish — priced per person, minimum two
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 宮崎の甘口醤油（マルタニ醤油）を使用＝小麦。Served with Miyazaki's characteristically sweet soy sauce — wheat. Ask for salt and wasabi.

items.ja: 宮崎県産鮮魚のなめろう
items.en: Namero — fish chopped on the board together with miso and aromatics until it turns into a paste. The shop hides yuzu-kosho in theirs
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 宮崎は麦味噌の産地であり、なめろうの味噌が麦味噌なら大麦＝グルテン。Miyazaki is barley-miso country, and if the miso in this namero is 麦味噌 it carries gluten. Ask which miso — this is not a paranoid question in this prefecture.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏入りフランク（一個）
items.en: A frankfurter packed with jitokko chicken
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: ソーセージの結着材に小麦を使う場合がある。Sausage binders often carry wheat — ask.

items.ja: 地鶏明太春巻き（2本）
items.en: Spring rolls of chicken and mentaiko with melting cheese and shiso
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 春巻きの皮は小麦、明太子の調味液にも醤油、チーズは乳。Spring-roll wrappers are wheat; mentaiko cure carries soy; cheese is dairy.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏砂肝コンフィ
items.en: Jitokko gizzards confited in jitokko chicken fat — chicken cooked in chicken
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 味付けは未公開。Seasoning not published — a salt-and-fat confit could be wheat-free but ask.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏入り梅水晶
items.en: Ume-suisho — shark cartilage in plum paste, made here with jitokko chicken through it. Crunchy, sour, built for shochu
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 梅水晶の調味に醤油・みりんを使うことが多い。Usually seasoned with soy and mirin — ask.

items.ja: クリームチーズの甘醤油漬け
items.en: Cream cheese steeped in Marutani soy sauce — Miyazaki's sweet soy — until the flavour goes all the way through
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 醤油漬け＝小麦、チーズ＝乳。Soy-cured, so wheat, and dairy.

items.ja: 蔵の厚焼き 卵焼き
items.en: Thick rolled omelette with, the shop says, the mouthfeel of a custard pudding
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: だし巻きの出汁・調味に醤油を使うのが一般的。Rolled omelette is normally seasoned with dashi and soy — ask. Egg.

items.ja: おびの天ぷら
items.en: Obiten — not tempura in the usual sense but a Nichinan speciality going back centuries: fish paste blended with tofu and brown sugar, then deep-fried into a sweet, dense cake
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: すり身のつなぎに小麦粉、味付けに醤油、共用の揚げ油。Fish-paste cakes are bound with wheat flour, seasoned with soy and fried in a shared fryer.

items.ja: マキシマムポテトフライ
items.en: Chips dusted with Maximum — the all-purpose spice mix Miyazaki households put on everything
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 共用フライヤーで唐揚げ・天ぷらと同じ油を使う。マキシマムの原材料にも要確認。The fryer is shared with wheat-battered karaage and obiten, so cross-contact is certain. Check the Maximum spice blend too.

items.ja: 漬物の盛り合わせ
items.en: Assorted pickles
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 漬物の漬け床に醤油・鰹だしを使うものがある。Some pickles are steeped in soy or bonito dashi — ask which ones are on the plate.

items.ja: なまり節のシーザーサラダ
items.en: Caesar salad with namaribushi — half-dried steamed bonito, flaked over the leaves
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: シーザードレッシングはアンチョビ・卵・チーズ、クルトンは小麦。Caesar dressing means anchovy, egg and cheese, and croutons are wheat.

items.ja: メヒカリの唐揚げ
items.en: Deep-fried mehikari — the small green-eyed deep-sea fish landed off Nobeoka, eaten whole
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 唐揚げの衣は小麦粉・片栗粉、下味に醤油。Karaage coating is wheat and potato starch with a soy marinade.

items.ja: 冷や汁セット
items.en: The cold miso soup over rice, offered as the finisher to a course or an à la carte evening
items.note: 宮崎の冷や汁は麦味噌が伝統＝大麦。焼き鯵・鰹だしも入る。Miyazaki hiyajiru is traditionally barley miso — gluten — plus grilled aji and bonito stock.

items.ja: カツオ飯セット
items.en: The soy-cured bonito over rice, as an evening finisher
items.note: 漬け地は醤油＝小麦。Soy cure.

items.ja: “炭薫る”みやざき地頭鶏親子丼
items.en: The charcoal-grilled jitokko oyakodon, as an evening finisher
items.note: 割下は醤油・味醂＝小麦、卵あり。Soy-and-mirin base, egg.

items.ja: 宮崎ごちそう御膳
items.en: The Miyazaki feast tray — the shop's set-piece plate, marked as recommended
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 構成品は未公開だが、南蛮・冷や汁・炭火焼きなど小麦を含む定番が入る想定。Contents not itemised; expect it to include the nanban and hiyajiru, both of which carry wheat.

items.ja: ご飯セット（ご飯とお味噌汁）
items.en: Rice and miso soup
items.note: 宮崎は麦味噌文化圏、味噌の種類を要確認。だしは鰹。Miyazaki is barley-miso country, so ask which miso; the dashi will be bonito either way.

items.ja: マルタ二醤油アイス
items.en: Soy-sauce ice cream made with Marutani, Miyazaki's sweet soy — savoury-sweet and much better than it sounds
items.note: 醤油＝小麦、アイス＝乳。Soy sauce means wheat; ice cream means dairy.

items.ja: 宮崎県産フローズンカットマンゴー
items.en: Frozen Miyazaki mango, cut — the prefecture's most famous fruit
items.note: 冷凍したマンゴー果肉のみ、加工調味なし。Nothing but frozen mango flesh — no wheat, no dairy, no additives. The one dessert here that clears both diets.

items.ja: チーズ饅頭にアイスを添えて
items.romaji: cheese manju ni ice wo soete
items.en: Miyazaki's own confection: a short pastry shell around cream cheese, served here warm with ice cream. With a teishoku, +¥550
items.note: 饅頭の皮は小麦粉、中はクリームチーズ、アイスは乳。The shell is wheat pastry, the filling is cream cheese and the ice cream is dairy.

items.ja: マンゴーソーダ（宮崎県産マンゴー果肉入り）
items.en: Mango soda with pieces of Miyazaki mango in it. With a teishoku, +¥660
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 果肉と炭酸。Fruit and carbonation. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: 平兵衛酢はちみつソーダ
items.en: Soda made with heibeizu — a rare citrus grown almost nowhere but Miyazaki — and honey. Gently sour. With a teishoku, +¥330
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: はちみつ使用のためヴィーガン不可。Contains honey, so not vegan. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: 日向夏ソーダ
items.en: Soda made with hyuganatsu, the Miyazaki citrus eaten with its white pith on — the shop's own note explains that is the trick to it
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 柑橘と炭酸。Citrus and soda. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: 愛のスコール（ご当地ドリンク）
items.en: Squall — the milky carbonated soft drink invented in Miyazaki in 1971 and still made by Nanyo Foods. Local to the point of being a mascot. With a teishoku, +¥330
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 乳性炭酸飲料のため乳成分あり。A milk-type carbonated drink — contains dairy. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: だれやみコース（当日可）
items.en: Four courses: seasonal starters, sashimi of the day, the charcoal-grilled jitokko, and a Miyazaki hassun tray. 'Dareyami' is the local word for the evening drink that stops you being tired. Bookable same day
items.note: 刺身の甘口醤油、八寸の煮物など醤油多用。Soy sauce runs through the sashimi and the hassun tray. Ask well in advance for a restricted diet.

items.ja: くわんね地鶏コース（当日可）
items.en: Eight courses: seasonal starters, sashimi of the day, a small hotpot, the charcoal-grilled jitokko, a palate cleanser, a Miyazaki hassun tray, then either katsuo-meshi or hiyajiru to finish, and dessert. 'Quwanne' is Miyazaki dialect for 'eat up'. Bookable same day
items.note: 〆に冷や汁を選ぶと麦味噌の可能性、小鍋・八寸にも醤油。If you pick hiyajiru as the finisher you may be getting barley miso; the hotpot and hassun are soy-seasoned regardless.

tokyo_with_green_shinjuku_sanc.price_note: Prices and compositions from WithGreen's own national menu page; every gluten and dairy call below is read directly off the company's own 28-item allergen chart, PDF dated 2026-07-01. Chain-wide pricing — the Shinjuku Sanchome branch (新宿3-1-17 山本ビル 1F, A2 exit 1 min, 16 seats, 11:00–21:00, eat-in L.O. 20:30) does not publish its own prices. Salads come in S/M/L. The chart's own caveat matters: toppings are assembled in a shared bowl line, so the company explicitly does not guarantee against cross-contact, and changing toppings voids the listed allergens. Prices approximate — may change.

items.ja: 1日分のまるごとサラダ
items.en: The whole day's vegetables in one bowl — 350g of them, no protein at all: carrot, daikon, tomato, red cabbage, cucumber, corn, grilled potato and onion. Recommended dressing: lemon. 118kcal for M without dressing
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 会社の公式アレルギー表（2026/7/1）でこのサラダ（ドレッシング抜き）は28品目すべて該当なし。レモンドレッシングも同様に該当なし。WithGreen's own allergen chart shows this salad, dressing excluded, with NOT ONE of the 28 listed allergens — no wheat, no dairy, no egg — and the recommended lemon dressing is likewise clear across the board. Pair those two and it is the single most reliably gluten-free and vegan bowl in this shard. The company still warns of topping cross-contact on the line.

items.ja: 甘辛きんぴらごぼうと玄米のサラダ
items.romaji: amakara kinpira gobo to genmai no salad
items.en: A Japanese-leaning bowl: sweet-savoury burdock kinpira, sweet potato, cucumber and brown rice. Recommended dressing: ginger. The cheapest salad on the card
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で小麦●（きんぴらごぼうが小麦・ごま・大豆）。推奨のジンジャードレッシングも卵●小麦●。The chart flags 小麦 on this salad through the kinpira itself, and the recommended ginger dressing carries wheat AND egg. Swap to lemon dressing and it is still wheat via the burdock. Otherwise plant-only — ask about the kinpira seasoning for vegan.

items.ja: 蒸し鶏とりんごのサラダ
items.en: Sweet vegetables throughout — sweet potato, apple, corn, carrot — with steamed chicken. The shop suggests it for a light meal or for children. Recommended dressing: citrus
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表でこのサラダは乳●のみ、小麦は該当なし。ただし推奨の柑橘ドレッシングは小麦●。The chart shows the salad itself carries dairy but NOT wheat — the wheat comes in with the recommended citrus dressing, which is flagged 小麦. Order it with lemon or ごま塩 dressing (both wheat-free on the chart) and you have a chicken salad without wheat. Ask about the dairy in the steamed chicken.

items.ja: 砂肝ともやしナムルのサラダ
items.romaji: sunagimo to moyashi namul no salad
items.en: Gizzard in a salad sounds odd and the shop says so on its own menu — it is one of the regulars' favourites. Bean-sprout namul, carrot, brown rice, daikon and chicken gizzard. Recommended dressing: sesame salt
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で小麦●（砂肝が小麦・ごま・大豆）。推奨のごま塩ドレッシングは小麦該当なし。The chart flags 小麦 on the gizzard itself, so the salad is wheat regardless of dressing — though the recommended sesame-salt dressing is one of the clean ones.

items.ja: 特製たれの棒棒鶏サラダ
items.romaji: tokusei tare no bang bang ji salad
items.en: Bang bang ji — poached chicken in a soy-sesame sauce — with carrot, bean-sprout namul, cucumber and tofu. The shop notes it is popular with people who train. Recommended dressing: onion
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●、原材料の一部にはちみつを含む。The chart flags both dairy and wheat — the bang bang ji sauce is soy-based, as the shop's own description says — and notes honey in the ingredients, so not vegan on two counts. The recommended onion dressing is also flagged 小麦.

items.ja: レッドチリチキンのコブサラダ
items.romaji: red chili chicken no Cobb salad
items.en: Cobb salad with spicy red-chilli chicken and boiled egg, red cabbage, tomato and cucumber — the most protein-dense bowl at 24.4g. Recommended dressing: Mexican
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で卵●乳●小麦●。推奨のメキシカンドレッシングは卵●乳●だが小麦は該当なし。Chart flags egg, dairy and wheat in the salad. The Mexican dressing is one of the wheat-free ones, but the chicken itself carries the wheat.

items.ja: キーマカレーとじゃがいもグリルのサラダ
items.romaji: keema curry to jagaimo grill no salad
items.en: Spiced keema curry over salad with apple, grilled potato, red cabbage and brown rice — the biggest bowl on the card at 311kcal. Recommended dressing: honey milk
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●、はちみつを含む。The chart flags dairy and wheat in the keema and notes honey. The recommended honey-milk dressing adds egg and dairy but no wheat.

items.ja: たっぷりスモークチキンのシーザーサラダ
items.romaji: tappuri smoked chicken no Caesar salad
items.en: Plenty of smoked chicken with corn, grilled potato, carrot and shio-koji shimeji mushrooms. Recommended dressing: Caesar
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 重要：公式アレルギー表ではサラダ本体（ドレッシング抜き）に小麦の表示がない一方、シーザードレッシング自体は卵●乳●小麦●落花生●。Worth knowing: on the chart the salad WITHOUT dressing shows no wheat at all — it is the Caesar dressing that carries wheat, egg, dairy and peanut. Order it with lemon or ごま塩 instead and the wheat goes away. Ask, because the recommendation is the problem, not the bowl.

items.ja: 低温ローストポークのごちそうサラダ
items.romaji: teion roast pork no gochiso salad
items.en: Sous-vide domestic pork leg with carrot, brown rice, apple and shio-koji shimeji — the shop pitches it at people who want to eat actual meat. Recommended dressing: ginger
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で卵●乳●小麦●、はちみつを含む。ローストポークのたれも小麦●。Chart flags egg, dairy and wheat in the salad, and separately flags wheat in the roast-pork sauce. Honey too.

items.ja: BBQチキンと彩り夏野菜のサラダ
items.romaji: BBQ chicken to irodori natsu-yasai no salad
items.en: Seasonal (summer): BBQ chicken with marinated onion, tomato, cucumber, red cabbage and corn. Recommended dressing: honey mustard
items.section: 季節限定サラダ Seasonal salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●（BBQチキンが原因）。推奨のハニーマスタードドレッシングは小麦該当なしだが、はちみつを含む。The chart flags dairy and wheat in the BBQ chicken. The honey-mustard dressing is wheat-free but contains honey.

items.ja: 肉味噌たっぷり麻婆春雨と夏採れズッキーニのサラダ
items.romaji: nikumiso tappuri mabo harusame to natsu-dore zucchini no salad
items.en: Seasonal (summer): mapo glass noodles heavy with meat miso, plus sweet-vinegared daikon, zucchini, carrot, tomato and tofu. Recommended dressing: creamy sesame
items.section: 季節限定サラダ Seasonal salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●落花生●。麻婆春雨そのものが小麦、大根の甘酢漬けも小麦。Chart flags dairy, wheat AND peanut. Two separate components carry wheat here — the mapo glass noodles and the sweet-vinegared daikon — so no dressing swap saves it.

items.ja: 自由に選べるカスタムサラダ
items.en: Build your own: pick five standard toppings and a dressing, add more for a fee. This is the route to a bowl that fits a restriction, because the company publishes an allergen line for every single topping
items.section: カスタムサラダ Custom salad
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で小麦「該当なし」のトッピング：人参・大根・オニオン・紫キャベツ・トマト・きゅうり・りんご・コーン・さつまいも・豆腐・もやしナムル・玄米・じゃがいもグリル・塩麹しめじ・ゆで卵（卵）・スモークチキン・オニオンマリネ・ズッキーニ。小麦●のトッピング：きんぴらごぼう・砂肝・棒棒鶏・レッドチリチキン・キーマカレー・ローストポーク（とそのたれ）・BBQチキン・麻婆春雨・大根の甘酢漬け・パン。蒸し鶏は乳●のみで小麦なし。The chart clears every plain vegetable topping, brown rice, tofu, shio-koji shimeji, grilled potato and — usefully — smoked chicken and steamed chicken of wheat, while flagging 小麦 on every sauce-carrying protein. Build from the cleared list and you get a genuinely wheat-free bowl. The company's own caveat still applies: shared line, cross-contact not guaranteed.

items.ja: トッピング［スタンダード］大根・豆腐・玄米・人参・紫キャベツ・さつまいも・トマト・コーン・きゅうり・りんご・オニオン・もやしナムル
items.en: Standard toppings, any of them: daikon, tofu, brown rice, carrot, red cabbage, sweet potato, tomato, corn, cucumber, apple, onion, bean-sprout namul. Five are included in a custom salad; extras are ¥110 each
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で12品すべて小麦・乳・卵とも「該当なし」（豆腐とりんごとナムルは大豆・りんご・ごまのみ表示）。All twelve are cleared of wheat, dairy and egg on the company's own chart — the only flags are soy (tofu, namul), sesame (namul) and apple. The brown rice is stated to be domestic.

items.ja: トッピング［プレミアム］じゃがいもグリル ¥150／塩麹しめじ ¥180／ゆで卵 ¥220／ちょい足し砂肝 ¥220／きんぴらごぼう ¥280／蒸し鶏 ¥370／砂肝 ¥410／レッドチリチキン ¥430／棒棒鶏 ¥440／キーマカレー ¥450／スモークチキン ¥500／ローストポーク ¥640
items.en: Premium toppings, priced individually from grilled potato at ¥150 up to roast pork at ¥640
items.note: 小麦「該当なし」：じゃがいもグリル・塩麹しめじ・ゆで卵（卵●）・スモークチキン・蒸し鶏（乳●）。小麦●：きんぴらごぼう・砂肝・棒棒鶏・レッドチリチキン・キーマカレー・ローストポーク。Read the chart before choosing: grilled potato, shio-koji shimeji, boiled egg, smoked chicken and steamed chicken carry no wheat, while every soy-sauced protein does. Smoked chicken at ¥500 is the wheat-free protein.

items.ja: トッピング［シーズナル］大根の甘酢漬け ¥110／オニオンマリネ ¥130／ズッキーニ ¥150／麻婆春雨 ¥390／BBQチキン ¥460
items.en: Seasonal toppings: sweet-vinegared daikon, marinated onion, zucchini, mapo glass noodles, BBQ chicken
items.note: 小麦「該当なし」：オニオンマリネ・ズッキーニ。小麦●：大根の甘酢漬け・麻婆春雨・BBQチキン。Marinated onion and zucchini are clear; the sweet-vinegared daikon is not — a ¥110 pickle carrying wheat is exactly the sort of thing that catches people out.

items.ja: ドレッシング［さっぱりタイプ］柑橘・ごま塩・オニオン・柚子しょうゆ・レモン・ハニーマスタード
items.en: Light dressings: citrus, sesame salt, onion, yuzu-soy, lemon, honey mustard. Any dressing can be swapped onto any salad at no charge
items.note: 公式アレルギー表：レモン＝28品目すべて該当なし。ごま塩＝ごま・大豆のみ。ハニーマスタード＝はちみつのみ。小麦●：柚子しょうゆ・柑橘・オニオン。Lemon is completely clean on the chart — no allergen at all — and sesame-salt carries only sesame and soy. Yuzu-soy, citrus and onion all carry wheat. Honey mustard is wheat-free but has honey, so not vegan.

items.ja: ドレッシング［クリーミータイプ］ナッツ・ごまクリーミー・バジルチーズ・ハニーミルク・メキシカン・シーザー・ジンジャー
items.en: Creamy dressings: nut, creamy sesame, basil cheese, honey milk, Mexican, Caesar, ginger
items.note: 小麦●：ジンジャー・ごまクリーミー・シーザー・ナッツ。小麦該当なし：バジルチーズ（卵●乳●）・ハニーミルク（卵●乳●）・メキシカン（卵●乳●）。すべて卵か乳を含みヴィーガン不可。Ginger, creamy sesame, Caesar and nut all carry wheat; basil cheese, honey milk and Mexican do not but all carry egg and dairy. None of the creamy dressings is vegan.

items.ja: スープ（ミネストローネ／オニオン／北海道産かぼちゃのポタージュ）
items.romaji: soup — minestrone / onion / Hokkaido kabocha potage
items.en: Soups: minestrone, onion, or Hokkaido pumpkin potage
items.note: 公式アレルギー表に掲載あり（3品とも複数のアレルゲン表示）。価格はメニューページに未掲載。All three appear on the company's allergen chart carrying multiple allergens, so none is a safe default — read the chart or ask. The menu page does not publish soup prices; read the counter board.

items.ja: パン
items.en: Bread, sold as a side
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●。Chart flags dairy and wheat. Price not published on the menu page.

tokyo_marugo_s.price_note: Transcribed in full from the shop's own site (marugo-s.com/s/), which publishes the entire card — curry, oysters, food, dessert, tea, coffee, beer, wine, cocktails and highballs. Prices as printed. The shop notes seasonal recommendations rotate. MARUGO S is a counter inside FOOD STADIUM in the yellow building at Tokyo Dome City, 文京区後楽1-3-61, 2F — 24 seats, staff take the order and hand the food over, and a sommelier will pick the wine with you. Open 11:00–23:00, food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30, no closing day. Expect it to be very busy for two hours either side of a Tokyo Dome event.

items.ja: スパイスカレー 1種／2種／3種
items.en: The counter's signature: choose one, two or three of the three spice curries on the plate. The shop describes it as an aroma that hits the nose first and a spice finish that keeps arriving. Add coriander, spiced pickled egg or a large rice for ¥200 each
items.note: スパイスから作るカレーはルウ不使用の場合が多いが、当店は原材料未公開。Spice curries built from whole spices often skip the wheat roux that a Japanese curry needs — so unlike most curry in this shard this one has a real chance. The shop publishes no allergen data, so ask directly about 小麦粉. All three curries contain meat.

items.ja: ラムと青唐辛子のキーマカレー
items.romaji: lamb to aotogarashi no keema curry
items.en: Curry 1 of 3: lamb keema with green chilli
items.note: 原材料未公開。Part of the plate above; no separate price. Ask about wheat.

items.ja: 手羽元とヘーゼルナッツのバターチキン
items.romaji: tebamoto to hazelnut no butter chicken
items.en: Curry 2 of 3: butter chicken made with wings, enriched with hazelnut
items.note: バターチキンは乳製品を含む、ヘーゼルナッツはナッツアレルギー注意。Butter chicken means dairy, and the hazelnut is a tree-nut warning that would be easy to miss from the name.

items.ja: 茨城県産 三右衛門豚のポークビンダル
items.en: Curry 3 of 3: pork vindaloo made with Sanemon pork from Ibaraki — the sour, vinegar-forward Goan curry
items.note: 原材料未公開。Ask about wheat.

items.ja: カレーの追加（追いパクチー／追いスパイス漬け卵／ライス大盛り）
items.en: Curry add-ons: extra coriander, an extra spiced pickled egg, or a large rice
items.note: スパイス漬け卵の漬け地は未公開。Coriander and rice are clean; the pickling liquid on the egg is not published.

items.ja: 本日の生牡蠣
items.en: The day's raw oyster, by the piece
items.note: 添えるソース（ミニョネット等）の内容は未公開。The oyster itself is clean; the accompanying sauce is not specified — ask, and take lemon if unsure.

items.ja: 生牡蠣2種食べ比べ
items.en: Two different oysters side by side, to taste against each other
items.note: 同上。Same — ask about the sauce.

items.ja: スパイス漬け卵のポテトサラダ
items.en: Potato salad with the house spiced pickled egg through it
items.note: ポテトサラダはマヨネーズ＝卵、漬け卵の漬け地は未公開。Mayonnaise means egg; the egg pickle's liquid is not published — ask if soy is in it.

items.ja: キャロットラペのシーフードマリネ
items.en: Carrot rapée with marinated seafood
items.note: マリネ液の内容は未公開。Marinade not itemised.

items.ja: ティムールペッパーとカカオニブの悶絶なめらかレバームース
items.romaji: Timur pepper to cacao nib no monzetsu nameraka liver mousse
items.en: 'Agonisingly smooth' chicken-liver mousse with Timur pepper — the Nepalese grapefruit-scented peppercorn — and cacao nibs
items.note: レバームースは通常バター・生クリーム＝乳、付け合わせのパンは小麦。Liver mousse is normally set with butter and cream, i.e. dairy, and if bread or toast comes with it that is wheat — ask whether it is served with anything.

items.ja: 鴨肉と赤玉葱のアチャール
items.en: Duck and red onion achar — the South Asian pickle treatment applied to duck
items.note: アチャールの漬け地は未公開。Pickling liquid not published.

items.ja: スモークサーモンとアボカド、ディルのマリネ
items.romaji: smoked salmon to avocado, dill no marine
items.en: Smoked salmon, avocado and dill, marinated
items.note: マリネ液は未公開。Marinade not published; smoked fish cures sometimes carry malt or soy.

items.ja: 低温調理の鶏むね肉のハム レモンとパセリのチミチュリ
items.romaji: teion chori no torimune-niku no ham, lemon to parsley no chimichurri
items.en: Sous-vide chicken-breast ham under a lemon-and-parsley chimichurri
items.note: チミチュリはオイル・酢・ハーブが基本で小麦不使用のことが多い。Chimichurri is oil, vinegar and herbs, so usually wheat-free — one of the better bets here, but the ham cure is unpublished. Ask.

items.ja: 麻婆青豆 -マーラーグリンピース-
items.en: Mapo green peas in mala numbing-hot spice — a joke on mapo tofu that works. The cheapest thing on the food card
items.note: 麻婆の豆板醤・甜麺醤は小麦を含むのが一般的、通常は豚挽肉入り。Mapo seasonings — doubanjiang and tianmianjiang — are both wheat-fermented as a rule, and mapo dishes normally carry minced pork. Not the vegetarian dish the name suggests.

items.ja: フランス産そら豆
items.en: French broad beans
items.note: 調理法・味付けは未公開。Preparation not published; broad beans themselves are clean.

items.ja: 甘海老のスパイスフリット
items.en: Sweet shrimp in spiced fritto batter
items.note: フリットの衣は小麦粉が基本、共用フライヤー。Fritto batter is wheat flour, and the fryer is shared with the chips and karaage.

items.ja: ラムのプロシェット 毛沢東風
items.en: Lamb brochette 'Mao Zedong style' — the shop tells you to bury it in Mao spice and says the leftover spice alone works as a snack. One skewer, extras ¥700 each
items.note: 毛沢東スパイスの原材料は未公開、中華スパイスミックスに小麦が入る場合がある。The Mao spice blend is not itemised; Chinese spice mixes sometimes carry wheat. Ask.

items.ja: ロングポテトフライ［スパイシー／海苔塩／ハーブソルト］
items.romaji: long potato fry — spicy / nori-shio / herb salt
items.en: Long chips with your choice of spicy, nori-salt or herb-salt seasoning
items.note: 共用フライヤーで小麦の衣物（フリット・唐揚げ）と同じ油。The fryer also handles wheat-battered fritto and karaage, so cross-contact is likely even if the chips and salt are clean.

items.ja: タンドリーチキン唐揚げ トマトヨーグルトとソルティヨーグルト
items.romaji: tandoori chicken karaage, tomato yoghurt to salty yoghurt
items.en: Tandoori-marinated chicken karaage with two yoghurt dips, tomato and salted
items.note: 唐揚げの衣は小麦粉・片栗粉、ヨーグルトは乳。Karaage coating is wheat-and-starch and the dips are dairy.

items.ja: 牛ほほ肉とローズマリーの赤ワイン煮込み
items.romaji: gyu-hoho-niku to rosemary no akawain nikomi
items.en: Beef cheek slow-braised in red wine with rosemary — the biggest plate on the food card
items.note: 赤ワイン煮込みのソースは小麦粉でとろみをつける場合がある。French-style braises are commonly thickened with flour — ask.

items.ja: 鶏むね肉のバターソテー ベルガモットとカルダモンのクリームソース
items.romaji: torimune-niku no butter saute, bergamot to cardamom no cream sauce
items.en: Butter-sautéed chicken breast in a bergamot-and-cardamom cream sauce
items.note: バター・生クリーム＝乳、クリームソースに小麦粉を使う場合がある。Butter and cream mean dairy; cream sauces are sometimes flour-thickened.

items.ja: 鹿のサルシッチャ
items.en: Venison salsiccia — house-made sausage from deer, which the shop says it preps at length. Extras ¥800
items.note: ソーセージの結着材に小麦を使う場合がある。Sausage binders can carry wheat — ask.

items.ja: 仔羊のチリコンカン
items.en: Lamb chilli con carne
items.note: チリコンカンは通常小麦不使用だが、付け合わせのパンやトルティーヤに注意。Chilli con carne is normally wheat-free in itself — watch for bread or a tortilla served alongside. Ask.

items.ja: 本日の冷製盛り合わせ
items.en: The day's cold-dish platter
items.note: 構成は日替わり。Composition changes daily — ask what is on it.

items.ja: 本日の温菜盛り合わせ
items.en: The day's hot-dish platter
items.note: 構成は日替わり、揚げ物が入る可能性が高い。Composition changes daily and will likely include something fried.

items.ja: ピスタチオとベリーのスノーシェイブ
items.romaji: pistachio to berry no snow shave
items.en: The shop's must-order dessert: 'snow shave', a shaved-ice dessert built to cool the mouth after the spice curry, with pistachio and berry
items.note: 乳製品を使う可能性が高い、ピスタチオはナッツアレルギー注意。Almost certainly dairy-based; pistachio is a tree-nut warning.

items.ja: TOKYO抹茶白玉ラテ／アイスと黒蜜付き
items.romaji: TOKYO matcha shiratama latte / ice to kuromitsu tsuki
items.en: Matcha latte with shiratama rice dumplings; ¥1,000 with ice cream and black-sugar syrup
items.note: 白玉は米粉で小麦不使用、ラテは乳。Shiratama is rice flour, so wheat-free; the latte itself is dairy.

items.ja: マルゴ自家製 限界突破生姜のジンジャーエール 甘口／辛口
items.romaji: Marugo jikasei genkai-toppa shoga no ginger ale, amakuchi / karakuchi
items.en: House 'limit-breaking ginger' ginger ale — sweet or hot
items.note: 生姜・砂糖・炭酸が基本。Ginger, sugar and soda. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: マルゴのマサラチャイ アイス／ホット
items.romaji: Marugo no masala chai, ice / hot
items.en: House masala chai, iced or hot
items.note: チャイは牛乳ベース。Milk-based. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: ギリシャヨーグルトのラッシー
items.en: Lassi made with Greek yoghurt
items.note: ヨーグルト＝乳。Dairy. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: アルトハウス紅茶（イングリッシュ・ブレックファースト／スパイス・パンチ／ミルク・ウーロン／カサブランカ・ミント／ルイボス・バニラ・トフィー／アーモンド・アップルパイ／ココ・トロピカル・ホワイト）
items.en: Seven blends from ALTHAUS, the German tea house: English Breakfast, Spice Punch, Milk Oolong, Casablanca Mint, Rooibos Vanilla Toffee, Almond Apple Pie, Coco Tropical White
items.section: TEA ティー［ドイツ産 アルトハウス社］
items.note: フレーバーティーの香料に麦芽由来成分が使われる場合がある。アーモンド・アップルパイはナッツ表記あり。Flavoured teas occasionally use malt-derived flavourings, and the Almond Apple Pie blend names a nut. The plain leaf teas are safe.

items.ja: アイスコーヒー／アイスカフェラテ／アイスキャラメルラテ／アイスカフェモカ
items.romaji: ice coffee / ice cafe latte / ice caramel latte / ice cafe mocha
items.en: Iced coffees, priced REGULAR / LARGE: coffee ¥500/¥600, latte ¥600/¥700, caramel latte ¥650/¥750, mocha ¥650/¥750
items.note: ラテ・モカは乳。ブラックのアイスコーヒーのみ植物性。Only the black iced coffee is dairy-free. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: ホットコーヒー ¥500／ホットカフェラテ ¥600／ホットキャラメルラテ ¥650／ホットカフェモカ ¥650／カプチーノ ¥600
items.romaji: hot coffee / cafe latte / caramel latte / cafe mocha / cappuccino
items.en: Hot coffees
items.note: ミルク入りは乳。Milk drinks are dairy; black coffee is not. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.en: Asahi Super Dry draught in three sizes — a Tokyo Dome-sized ladder
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: シャンディガフ
items.en: Shandy — beer and ginger ale
items.note: ビールベース＝麦芽。Beer-based. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 倍倍エキスのレッドアイ
items.en: Red Eye — beer and tomato juice, made here with a doubled tomato extract
items.note: ビールベース＝麦芽。Beer-based. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.en: Sparkling by the glass or bottle: Champagne, and a house sparkling
items.note: 清澄剤は未公開。Fining agents not published, which is the only vegan question wine raises. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask. items.note: Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: バイマックルー ジントニック
items.en: Gin and tonic scented with makrut lime leaf
items.note: ジンの原料穀物は銘柄により小麦の場合がある。Gin is distilled, but the base grain is sometimes wheat — distillation removes gluten protein, and most coeliac guidance treats distilled spirits as safe. Ask if you are strict.

items.ja: トロピカル・ピニャコラーダ
items.en: Piña colada
items.note: ココナッツクリームのほか乳製品を使う場合がある。Often made with dairy cream as well as coconut — ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 倍倍エキスのブラッディ・マリー
items.en: Bloody Mary with the doubled tomato extract
items.note: ウスターソースを加える場合があり、これは小麦を含む。Bloody Marys are commonly spiked with Worcestershire sauce, which contains wheat and anchovy — ask.

items.ja: カルダモン香るレモンサワー
items.en: Lemon sour scented with cardamom
items.note: ベーススピリッツは未公開、麦焼酎の可能性を要確認。Base spirit not stated — rule out barley shochu.

items.ja: 限界突破生姜のモスコミュール
items.en: Moscow mule made with the house 'limit-breaking' ginger
items.note: ウォッカの原料穀物は銘柄により小麦。Vodka's base grain is sometimes wheat, though distilled.

items.ja: マルゴのサングリア／デキャンタ
items.en: House sangria, by the glass or as a 500ml decanter
items.note: 清澄剤・甘味料は未公開。Fining agents and sweeteners not published. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: ハイボール（プレミアム［デュワーズ15年］¥1,000／ミズナラ［シーバスリーガル12年］¥800／ペッパー［タリスカー10年］¥900／シナモン［エズラブルックス99］¥900／コーク［ワイルドターキー8年］¥800／ジンジャー［グレングラント アルボラリス］¥800）
items.en: Six highballs, each named for its whisky: Dewar's 15, Chivas Regal 12 with mizunara, Talisker 10 with pepper, Ezra Brooks 99 with cinnamon, Wild Turkey 8 with cola, Glen Grant Arboralis with ginger
items.note: ウイスキーは大麦麦芽由来。Whisky is barley malt. Distillation removes the gluten protein and many coeliac bodies consider distilled spirits safe, but this project treats malt drinks as not gluten-free. Vegan on the ingredients — brewed and distilled drinks are plant-based. The rare exception is animal finings used to clarify some beers and wines, which are never declared on a Japanese menu.

items.ja: ジョニーウォーカー ブルーラベル Half(20ml) ¥1,800／Shot(35ml) ¥2,500
items.en: Johnnie Walker Blue Label, half measure or full shot
items.note: スコッチ＝大麦麦芽由来。Scotch — barley malt. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

tokyo_jikasei_mensho_shibuya_p.price_note: The item list, the English names and — importantly — the ヴィーガン / Vegan tags are the shop's own, from MENSHO's branch page for Jikasei MENSHO Shibuya in both Japanese and English. Prices are tax-included figures from the branch's Tabelog card, updated 2026-06-26 and matching the shop's item list line for line. Prices approximate — may change. B1F Shibuya PARCO, 15-1 Udagawacho; daily 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closes with PARCO. Ordering and payment are at the table, self-checkout.

items.ja: 白トリュフ香るA5和牛のせ鶏白湯らぁ麺
items.romaji: shiro-truffle kaoru A5 wagyu-nose tori-paitan raamen
items.en: The signature bowl: creamy chicken paitan under slices of A5 Japanese wagyu, scented with white truffle. This is the flagship dish of the Jikasei MENSHO brand, whose original branch is inside the X (formerly Twitter) building in the US
items.note: 自家製麺は小麦（MENSHOは製粉から手掛ける麺屋）。タレも醤油系。The whole point of MENSHO is milling its own wheat and making its own noodles, so the noodle is emphatically wheat. Chicken broth, beef topping.

items.ja: 柚子香るA5和牛のせ鶏白湯らぁ麺
items.romaji: yuzu kaoru A5 wagyu-nose tori-paitan raamen
items.en: The same wagyu-topped chicken paitan, lifted with yuzu instead of truffle
items.note: 自家製小麦麺、鶏白湯、和牛。Wheat noodles, chicken broth, beef.

items.ja: 醤油らぁ麺
items.en: Classic shoyu ramen
items.note: 醤油＝小麦、麺＝小麦。Wheat in both the tare and the noodle.

items.ja: 醤油メンマらぁ麺
items.en: Shoyu ramen with a full load of menma bamboo shoot
items.note: メンマの味付けにも醤油。The menma is soy-seasoned too.

items.ja: 塩らぁ麺
items.en: Classic shio (salt) ramen
items.note: 塩ダレでも自家製麺は小麦、スープは動物系。Salt tare rather than soy, but the noodle is still wheat and the stock is animal.

items.ja: 塩メンマらぁ麺
items.en: Shio ramen with a full load of menma
items.note: 麺＝小麦、メンマの味付けは要確認。Wheat noodles.

items.ja: お子様らぁ麺セット
items.en: Mini ramen set for children
items.note: 麺＝小麦。Wheat noodles.

items.ja: ヴィーガン担々麺
items.en: Vegan tantanmen — sesame-and-chilli soup tantanmen built without any animal product. The shop tags it ヴィーガン itself
items.note: 店の公式サイトが「ヴィーガン」と明示。ただし自家製麺は小麦であり、グルテンフリーではない。MENSHO labels this vegan on its own site in both Japanese and English, so the vegan claim is the shop's, not an inference — MENSHO has run vegan ramen for years and is one of the few Tokyo ramen groups to do it seriously. It is NOT gluten-free: the noodle is wheat, and tantan seasoning is soy-based. Vegan and gluten-free are different questions and this bowl answers only one of them.

items.ja: ヴィーガン汁なし担々麺
items.en: Vegan soupless tantanmen — the dry version, tossed rather than served in broth. Shop-tagged vegan
items.note: 店の公式サイトが「ヴィーガン」と明示。麺は小麦。Shop-labelled vegan; wheat noodles.

items.ja: ヴィーガン味噌らぁ麺
items.en: Vegan miso ramen. Shop-tagged vegan
items.note: 店の公式サイトが「ヴィーガン」と明示。味噌の種類（麦味噌か米味噌か）は未公開、麺は小麦なので結論は変わらない。Shop-labelled vegan. The miso type is not published — a 麦味噌 would be barley — but the wheat noodle settles the gluten question either way.

items.ja: スパイシーヴィーガン味噌らぁ麺
items.en: Spicy vegan miso ramen. Shop-tagged vegan
items.note: 店の公式サイトが「ヴィーガン」と明示。麺は小麦。Shop-labelled vegan; wheat noodles.

items.ja: 白めし
items.en: Plain white rice
items.section: サイドメニュー Side menu
items.note: 白米のみ、味付けなし。Plain steamed rice, unseasoned — no wheat and no animal product. Combined with a vegan bowl's toppings it is the only route here for someone avoiding both.

items.ja: 葱めし
items.en: Rice bowl under spring onion
items.section: サイドメニュー Side menu
items.note: 葱めしのタレは通常ごま油・塩または醤油。The dressing on a negi-meshi is normally sesame oil and salt, sometimes soy — ask which.

items.ja: 肉めし
items.en: Rice bowl topped with pork chashu
